overview: Establishes the foundational data model and security architecture for the Annual Activity Review (AAR) module. Includes all custom objects, relationships, and record-level security configurations required to support the AAR workflow.
scope: AAR custom object and related child objects (Submission, Reviewer)
Object relationships and data model integrity
Record-level security model aligned with Business Hub governance
Evaluator permission sets and sharing rules
success_criteria: All AAR objects created with appropriate fields and relationships
PIs can only access their own AAR records
Evaluators can access assigned AARs with appropriate read/edit permissions
Institute leadership has visibility to their institute's AARs

decision_authority.name: Rob Chen
decision_authority.note: Approval required to proceed to Phase 2

technical_readiness: All MVP Phase 1 stories marked Done (0 remaining open issues)
UAT sign-off from Research Institute stakeholders
Performance benchmarks met (page load <3s, query execution <2s)
user_adoption: Minimum 80% PI completion rate in pilot institute
<10% support ticket volume relative to user base
Evaluator workflow validated with minimum 5 completed reviews
Institute admin dashboard actively used by at least 1 institute
data_quality: Integration with Grants system validated (100% match on active PIs)
Pre-population accuracy >95% (measured via PI correction rate)
Zero data integrity issues in AAR submission workflow
governance: Data retention policy documented and approved
Security review signed off by Information Security
Change management plan executed (training materials delivered)

known_child_stories.summary: Create AAR custom object with attestation support and deadline configuration
